sections.title: Commercial roofing contractor serving Mission
paras: Edel Roofing is based in Edinburg, about 25 minutes from Mission, and has been working on commercial properties across Hidalgo County since 2003. We handle flat and low-slope roofing for strip centers, medical buildings, offices, and warehouses throughout Mission.

Mission's commercial corridor runs along Expressway 83, with more retail and medical buildings clustered near Mission Regional Medical Center. Most of those are flat-roof buildings, and a good number are original construction from the 1980s and 90s now approaching or past their expected service life.

Commercial work requires a different level of planning than residential. Tenants are affected, business hours matter, and a roof failure is not just a property problem, it's an operations problem. We inspect before we estimate, put everything in writing, and schedule around your building's needs.

cards.title: Flat Roof Installation
cards.body: New flat and low-slope roof systems for commercial buildings in Mission. We install TPO, EPDM, and modified bitumen membranes, the three systems most commonly used on commercial properties across South Texas.

cards.title: Commercial Roof Replacement
cards.body: Full tear-off and replacement when a commercial roof has run its course. We remove the old system, inspect the decking for water damage, and install a new commercial-grade roof with a written scope and timeline.

cards.title: Commercial Roof Repairs
cards.body: Leak repairs, membrane patching, flashing repairs, and drain issues on existing commercial roofs. We locate the actual source of the problem, not just the spot where water shows up inside, and fix it.

cards.title: Roof Coatings
cards.body: Reflective coatings applied over existing commercial membranes to extend service life and reduce heat load. In Mission's climate, a good coating can meaningfully lower cooling costs and buy years of additional life from an otherwise sound roof.

cards.title: Storm & Hail Damage
cards.body: Hidalgo County hailstorms hit commercial roofs hard. We inspect for impact damage, membrane ruptures, and flashing failures, and we provide written documentation that is useful when you contact your insurance company.

cards.title: Commercial Roof Inspections
cards.body: Routine inspections for property managers and building owners who want to catch problems before they become expensive. We walk the roof, document conditions, and give you a clear report on what needs attention and what can wait.

sections.title: What commercial roofing looks like in Mission
paras: The Expressway 83 corridor is Mission's main commercial spine, strip centers, retail buildings, and office space, much of it flat-roofed and a meaningful share of it built decades ago. Those older roofs are now well into or past the back half of their service life, which is when a coating or a full replacement becomes the real conversation rather than another patch.

Near Mission Regional Medical Center, the mix shifts toward medical offices and specialty buildings. A roof failure there is a different kind of problem, it cannot wait, and the work often needs to happen without disrupting patients or staff.

We work with building owners, property managers, and business owners across all of these property types. If you manage multiple Mission buildings and want a contractor who can handle the commercial side consistently, call us and we can talk about what a regular inspection and maintenance relationship looks like.

faqs.q: My business in Mission has a flat roof leak. Can you fix it?
faqs.a: Yes. We repair flat and low-slope commercial roofs throughout Mission. Flat roof leaks are harder to trace than residential leaks because water travels along the membrane before it shows up inside. We inspect the full roof to find the actual entry point, not just the visible damage. Call (956) 422-3335 to schedule an inspection.

faqs.q: What types of commercial roofing do you install in Mission?
faqs.a: We install TPO, EPDM, and modified bitumen membrane systems, the three most common flat and low-slope commercial systems in South Texas. We also apply roof coatings for buildings that need extended service life without a full replacement. We can recommend the right system based on your building type, roof area, and budget.

faqs.q: How long does a commercial roof last in Mission's climate?
faqs.a: A well-installed commercial membrane system in the RGV typically lasts 15 to 25 years, depending on the material and how consistently it is maintained. Mission's heat and UV exposure accelerate wear compared to cooler climates. Regular inspections catch small problems before they shorten that timeline.

faqs.q: Do you work with property managers overseeing multiple Mission buildings?
faqs.a: Yes. A significant portion of our commercial work is with property managers and building owners with multiple properties. We can work around tenant schedules, provide documentation for insurance and maintenance records, and set up recurring inspection agreements so problems get caught early across all your buildings.

faqs.q: How do I get a commercial roofing estimate in Mission?
faqs.a: Call (956) 422-3335 or book an inspection online. We will schedule a time to walk the roof, take measurements, and give you a written estimate. Commercial estimates are free with no obligation.
